Title: Azure Monitor Logs new create workspace experience

Body.Content:
Collect and analyze logs from your Azure estate using the power and flexibility of Azure Monitor Logs.

The Azure Monitor Logs workspace is the most basic logical unit used to collect and manage log analytics.

The workspace creation experience has been modernized and there’s a new, full-screen create experience.

This experience features a variety of usability and documentation enhancements for a better, smoother workspace creation experience that's more consistent with other Azure experiences.

We appreciate your feedback. If you have questions or suggestions, please email us.
